item.title: How politics in Minneapolis are putting law enforcement at risk
item.description: Minneapolis offers a warning for law enforcement leaders as political conflict undermines coordination and officer safety

item.title: Shots Fired: Federal agents shooting Alex Pretti in Minneapolis
item.description: How crowd dynamics, officer training and real-time decisions shaped the narrative before the investigation began

item.title: Calif. city to pay $1.7M in former PD sergeant’s wrongful termination, harassment suit
item.description: The former Fresno PD sergeant filed a lawsuit claiming she was sexually harassed by members of the K-9 unit and was wrongfully terminated for attempts to stop the harrassment

item.title: LAPD would delete nearly 12 million body camera videos under proposed policy change
item.description: Most of the videos gathered by officers go unwatched, with LAPD officials saying there's not enough manpower to review all of the clips recorded on any given shift

item.title: Dashcam: 17-year-old suspect flees Ga. lieutenant at more than 115 mph before rollover crash
item.description: A Fayette County Sheriff's lieutenant initiated the pursuit after spotting a vehicle reported stolen; the suspect fled at high speeds for several minutes before losing control and crashing

item.title: NYPD cop saves second baby from choking in 2 months
item.description: Just weeks after saving a neighbor’s choking 1-year-old girl, an NYPD officer was at it again, saving the life of a 2-year-old boy who had stopped breathing

item.title: Tenn. deputy fatally shot while responding to shots fired call
item.description: The suspect allegedly fired the first shot from a vehicle, causing Weakley County Deputy Derrick Bonham to fall, then exited and fired again
